scores.rationale: HEAD matched the exact candidate. The frozen contract pins the baseline and candidate fingerprint scope, and composite mutations passed for exact IDs, weights, provenance, thresholds, donor decisions, baseline branch consistency, candidate binding, arbitrary-SHA rejection, and post-candidate drift.

Canonical authority and source-return structure passed the Wiki, editorial-depth, and source-return baselines. Mutations rejected missing authority, unknown canonical references, broken relations, missing approved pages, missing source-return sections, and incomplete source-class coverage.

Agency relations retain exact-set proof coverage, bounded action, collective credit, canonical support, confidence, and anti-claims. Composite mutations rejected missing classifications, sole causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, unknown support, and endorsement drift; editorial mutations also rejected collapsed identity contribution types.

Focused composite mutations verified that intake and query operators reject unsafe input, preserve canonical graph integrity, and remain non-promoting. Leak checks reject private locators, credentials, and rendered phone strings and fail closed when output is absent.

Survivorship and source-return controls preserve bounded non-recovery language, separate rights dimensions, protected-source boundaries, and governed re-entry. Mutations rejected historical-absence overclaim, automatic promotion, incomplete source classes, private locators, and closure of the human librarian gate.

Composition and mosaic controls passed exact-set route, proof, projection, omission, budget, combination-risk, continuing-hold, and candidate-binding checks. Wiki mutations separately rejected unsafe media projection, private records, pending-rights media, and non-recovery used as positive evidence.

The exact candidate SHA was verified and the supplied contract and candidate fingerprints are consistently bound in the candidate validation layer. Receipt schema, self-grading, duplicate criteria, stale dates, candidate drift, invented evidence, unresolved defects, and aggregate derivation are mutation-tested. As an individual receipt, this score is capped at 3.

The focused Wiki, source-return, editorial-depth, and composite mutation suites all passed under Node 26.5.0. Full application build, browser, accessibility, and production-runtime layers were outside this focused execution, so release evidence is strong but not complete.

Human-only authority remains explicit and mutation-sensitive. Tests reject automated human approval; editorial mutations reject resolving Jamie's first-person authorship gate, unlabeled AI-assisted first-person drafts, and projection-ready first-person drafts. Place and participant boundaries, present-day place safety inference, protected academic identity, private voice sources, and governed re-entry are also enforced.
